title: apps/gateway config_cbor.c uses undeclared strnlen: same minimal-libc -Werror build break
description: Found by review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-zhyq (P2 sibling; same class as wmae/zhyq). lichen/apps/gateway/src/config_cbor.c:254 calls strnlen (live, undeclared in Zephyr minimal libc -> implicit-function-declaration -Werror breaks the gateway app build that pulls this file). Fix: mirror the reviewed memchr pattern (see wmae/zhyq for the exact form; preserve the call site's exact max_len+1 scan envelope and NULL/edge semantics). Verify: the gateway app build for native_sim v4.1.0 (apps/gateway) - note it may hit other v4.1.0 issues (coap cluster) but the compile of config_cbor.c specifically is the gate. Also grep the gateway app dir for any further strnlen sites while there. Note: coap_status.c:495,498 strnlen sites are covered by af780aefe1 on beads-worker-2 (merges cleanly).
